(rule!
  ;; alt: the original build-grid version spelled out the same four quadrants.
  (stack-grids 'vertical
    (list
      (stack-grids 'horizontal (list g (rotate-cw g)))
      (stack-grids 'horizontal (list (rotate-ccw g) (rotate-180 g))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
  (let* ((objs (objects g 0))
         (chosen (argmax obj-size objs))
         (bb (obj-bbox chosen))
         (cells (obj-cells chosen))
         (source (grid-from-fn (+ 1 (- (third bb) (first bb)))
                               (+ 1 (- (fourth bb) (second bb)))
                   (lambda (r c)
                     (if (member (list (+ r (first bb)) (+ c (second bb))) cells)
                         (obj-color chosen) 0)))))
    (stack-grids 'vertical
      (list (stack-grids 'horizontal (list source (rotate-cw source)))
            (stack-grids 'horizontal (list (rotate-ccw source) (rotate-180 source))))))))

(rule!
  (let* ((h (rows g))
         (w (cols g))
         (last-r (- h 1))
         (last-c (- w 1))
         (normalized
           (cond
             ((= (at g 0 0) 9) g)
             ((= (at g 0 last-c) 9) (rotate-ccw g))
             ((= (at g last-r last-c) 9) (rotate-180 g))
             ((= (at g last-r 0) 9) (rotate-cw g))
             (else g))))
    (stack-grids 'vertical
      (list
        (stack-grids 'horizontal (list normalized (rotate-cw normalized)))
        (stack-grids 'horizontal (list (rotate-ccw normalized) (rotate-180 normalized)))))))
